title: Generating a noisy learning curve
description: You can compare the underlying power-law formula with its synthetic observations.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You create trial numbers starting at 1 and set T1 and ALPHA. Starting at one gives the first power-law input a positive value.
true_time multiplies T1 by trials raised to negative ALPHA. With positive ALPHA, the formula decreases as trial number grows.

steps.question: Does this expression add noise to true_time?
steps.answer: No. It multiplies true_time by lognormal random factors to form observed.

steps.description: You plot observations as markers and the underlying curve as a red line. The supplied recording contains no rendered figure or text output to inspect.
